phase1_easy.description: Shopify + WooCommerce sites with working APIs — 20 roasters, zero HTML parsing needed
phase1_easy.shopify_approach: GET /products.json?limit=250, paginate, map product JSON to RawProduct
phase1_easy.woocommerce_approach: GET /wp-json/wc/store/v1/products?per_page=100, paginate, map to RawProduct. NOTE: some WooCommerce prices are in kuruş (divide by 100 for TL)

phase2_medium.description: Ikas + Ticimax sites — 8 roasters, need cheerio HTML scraping
phase2_medium.approach: Load product listing pages, extract with CSS selectors. Ikas sites share similar DOM structure.

phase3_hard.description: Custom, Wix, Squarespace, Square Online sites — 16 roasters, each needs individual scraper
phase3_hard.approach: Custom cheerio scrapers per site. Wix sites may need puppeteer. Consider deprioritizing these for MVP.
